current_bottleneck: The current best remains 377a at 8/11. The stable bottleneck is conditional per-cell uncertainty geometry: daily move realism and cointegration are mostly fine, but level occupancy and asymmetric cell-wise width allocation fail persistently.
last_result_summary: 383a compared 340c_revised, 377a_full_adapt, 381_conditioning, 381_conditioning_memory, and 382_anchor1. Across the family, daily KS is 24/25 or 25/25, while level KS remains 5-13/25 and regime layer2 remains 0/8 or 1/8. Undercoverage concentrates in cells (0,3) and (1,3), while overcoverage concentrates in different wing/corner cells such as (4,0), (4,1), and (4,4). This rules out scalar temperature, sample mixture, and simple adaptation anchoring as sufficient.
next_step_recommendation: Run a clean in-model uncertainty-geometry experiment: add a learned conditional diagonal noise-scale/readout in normal-score transition space, trained with the same FM objective and sampled by scaling the base noise before integration. This is more principled than post-hoc calibration because the model learns conditional per-cell uncertainty from history/current state rather than hand-setting cell gates.
